open_comment_speakers.name: Tim Thomas
open_comment_speakers.topic: spoke to council goals, acknowledged that all are laudible goals however raised new issues; 1) plurality 2) ethics 3) transparency – a strength fo the city, and 4) majority rules with protection of minority rights.

open_comment_speakers.name: Erin Hamby
open_comment_speakers.topic: played a DVD promoting the Mayor’s for Peace – 2020 Vision – requested that the City of Boulder consider adoption of this resolution.

open_comment_speakers.name: Mary Louise Chavers
open_comment_speakers.topic: Eco System – thanked City Manager Bruno for his consideration for protecting the Prairie Dogs.

open_comment_speakers.name: Dan Sukle
open_comment_speakers.topic: opposed to the number of increased “no dog” trails proposed by the OSMP Board in the Open Space Visitor Plan.

open_comment_speakers.name: Robin Beeck
open_comment_speakers.topic: spoke to the First Annual Boulder International Film Festival. Turn out surpassed all expectations.

open_comment_speakers.name: Lori Fuller
open_comment_speakers.topic: their request for sight and voice control on 4 of the trails proposed as no dog trails in the Open Space Visitor Plan.

open_comment_speakers.name: Rob Smoke
open_comment_speakers.topic: Encouraged Council to carefully consider a movement to allow people to party responsibly.

open_comment_speakers.name: Alan Rudy
open_comment_speakers.topic: expressed concern that Prairie dogs may destroy the beautiful Parks and Open Space.

open_comment_speakers.name: Chris Morrison
open_comment_speakers.topic: FIDO member also spoke in support of sight and voice control of dogs on trails in HCA areas of Open Space.

motions.motion_text: Councilmember Gray moved, seconded by Jack Stoakes to adjourn from the Boulder City Council and convene as the General Canvassing and Election Board for the City of Boulder General Coordinated Municipal Election.
Councilmember Gray moved, seconded by Riggle to nominate Mayor Ruzzin to chair the Board.
Councilmember Gray moved, seconded by Eldridge to approve the abstract and result sheets.
MOTION TO ADJOURN FROM THE GENERAL CANVASSING AND ELECTION BOARD FOR THE GENERAL COORDINATED MUNICIPAL ELECTION AND RECONVENE AS THE BOULDER CITY COUNCIL.
motions.vote_text: Seeing no objection the motion was approved by acclamation.

motions.motion_text: Councilmember Gray moved, seconded by McGrath to approve consent items 3A through 3F with Councilmember Eldridge recused from item 3F.
Councilmember Eldridge moved, seconded by Stoakes to adopt Ordinance No. 7416.
Councilmember McGrath moved, seconded by Gray to amend the ordinance to strike “not eligible to marry under state law” thus supporting the original language.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried 7:2; Eldridge and Riggle opposed.

motions.motion_text: Councilmember McGrath moved, seconded by Ruzzin to amend the ordinance to limit private registry to same sex couples for the purposes of occupancy in section 12-4-6 of this ordinance.
motions.vote_text: The motion failed 1:8, McGrath in favor.

motions.motion_text: Councilmember Gray moved, seconded by McGrath to suspend the rules and continue the meeting.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried 6:3; Eldridge, Riggle and Stoakes opposed.

motions.motion_text: Councilmember Gray moved seconded by McGrath to ratify appointments to the Boards and Commissions.
Councilmember Eldridge moved, seconded by Riggle to appoint Dr. David Frederick to the Council Audit Committee for a 2 year term.
BY MOTION REGULARLY ADOPTED, THE MEETING WAS ADJOURNED AT 10:50P.M.
motions.vote_text: There being no further business to come before Council at this time, BY MOTION REGULARLY ADOPTED, THE MEETING WAS ADJOURNED AT 10:50P.M.
